source_primary.title: Topological Robustness of Orbital Angular Momentum Entanglement in Stochastic Channels
source_primary.data_availability: TOKEN_VAZIO_PUBLIC_DATA; authors state data are not publicly available and are available upon reasonable request

execution.scope: Mathematical topological-degree mechanism only; not the paper's optical turbulence experiment, QST, photon counts, or full numerical channel.

results.sign_convention: positive input winding gives negative numerical Q for the selected theta convention; compare absolute charge

uncertainties.detail: Finite-domain and finite-difference errors leave approximately 0.64% to 3.06% relative absolute-charge error at grid 181. No rounding-to-integer is used as evidence.
No independent SPDC/SLM/QST laboratory reproduction was performed.
Primary paper states data are not publicly available; exact raw counts and experimental realizations were therefore not independently reanalysed.
This receipt does not claim faithful reproduction of the paper's atmospheric-turbulence simulation or all Supplementary figures.
No theorem or empirical result establishes that a RAFAELIA invariant is equivalent to the paper's skyrmion number. Any present connection is an analogy/hypothesis only.

priority.next_verifiable_action: Obtain authors' raw dataset / turbulence realizations or an official public release, hash exact bytes, then independently recompute reported N, purity and error bars.
